title: Kehti Thi Rokar Zainab
body:
kehti thi ro kar zainab e kubra
ek dukhiyari meri sakina
pani ko tarsi wawaila
ek dukhiyari meri sakina
kehti thi ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
chote chote baalon waali
haye meri naazon ki paali
kaise chupaye apna chehra
ek dukhiyari meri sakina
kehti thi ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr e layeen ne kaano se gauhar
cheen liye qaimon ko jala kar
kehti rahi ro ro ke baba
ek dukhiyari meri sakina
kehti thi ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime may kohraam hai barpa
aag lagane aaye hai aada
poochti hai nana ka rauza
ek dukhiyari meri sakina
kehti thi ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban ka sannata
hoo ka aalam sehra sehra
dhoond rahi hai baap ka laasha
ek dukhiyari meri sakina
kehti thi ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
is qaime se us qaime may
jaati hai ghabrayi hui si
saath liye asghar ka jhoola
ek dukhiyari meri sakina
kehti thi ro kar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain ye thay zainab ke ishrat
ho gayi is dunya se ruqsat
daaghe alam ka de kar tohfa
ek dukhiyari meri sakina
kehti thi ro kar...
author: Ishrat Lakhnavi
